text:
noah: Observability found KMS-wrapped ciphertexts in an ingest pod stdout during a partner rollout. small count but P1. snippet: 

noah: ```
2025-11-02T15:04:12Z INFO ingest: wrote blob id=bd-77 wrap_ct=CmZ...
```

priya: Which key/SA? any hostPath mounts?

noah: Key appears to be projects/redwood-prod/.../keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap-v9. partner SA partner-rollout@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com had encrypter rights for onboarding. Chart values show a compat shim that may have mounted a keystore.

devsec-bot: ALERT: IAM event - partner-rollout@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com called cloudkms.encrypt on ingest-wrap-v9 at 2025-11-02T15:04:13Z.

vaultd: Vault audit for namespace "ingest" shows wrap metadata writes during the window. retention currently 30d; recommend increase to 90d for incident window.

priya: Immediate actions: 1) revoke encrypter grant for partner SA (noah) 2) create new wrap key (ingest-wrap-rot1) and enable dual-wrap reads for 24h (priya) 3) export hitlist from storage logs to gs://redwood-sec/incident-3876543210/hitlist.json (acl: infra-sec-only) (noah) 4) run dry-run rewrap in staging then small prod batches (owner: priya) 5) add OPA/Gatekeeper constraint to block hostPath mounts in ingest namespaces and update helm chart (infra-bot) 6) bump Vault audit retention to 90d and add alert wrap_calls_by_sa > 3/min => page (vaultd).

noah: Revoking binding now and will push TF change to remove encrypter.

priya: Rewrap dry-run command (staging): 

priya: ```bash
python infra/rewrap.py --hitlist gs://redwood-sec/incident-3876543210/hitlist.json --src-key projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-v9 --dst-key projects/redwood-prod/.../ingest-wrap-rot1 --batch 100 --dry-run
```

oncall: I'll coordinate a 30m deploy freeze for the prod rewrap canary, ETA 45m. abort if decrypt errors >0.5%.

infra-bot: Created policy PR to deny hostPath mounts in ingest namespaces: https://git.redwood.internal/policies/opa/pull/999

vaultd: Updating retention + alert, will link PR when done.

devsec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2401 "ingest keystore stdout leak -> rewrap + RBAC + admission policy". Assignees: noah, priya. Priority: P1.

priya: After rewrap we'll rotate any CI tokens or long-lived secrets that referenced affected blobs and schedule a 72h hold before retiring old key versions. I'll post dry-run results here.
